_about: Default key bindings (D6; jump and dodge added at Sam's request, 2026-10-03), as KeyboardEvent.code values. The action names are sim::Input::ACTIONS; the page reads the bits from there. A player's own bindings, once Settings has them, live in the save file. One player: the left hand moves (A and D step, W jumps, S stands up, Left Shift dodges) and the right hand drives the arm (I and K the shoulder, J and L the elbow), at Sam's request (2026-10-03). _solo_before is the earlier layout: a save still holding it exactly is moved to the new one. The throw (2026-10-05) is O for one player, beside the arm keys, T for the left player and M for the right.
